texts.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Zenet" Traps from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 3 Normal Monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep" once per turn.
texts.name: Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep
